notes.title: 🎵 ver 1.0.2 Update 🎵
notes.content: [p]We have made the following adjustments in ver 1.0.2![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Main Updates:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the timing adjustment UI to make it easier to use.[/p][/*][*][p]The timing adjustment offset can now be fine-tuned in 1ms increments.[/p][/*][*][p]The timing adjustment offset is now applied only to the character’s movements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when playing a rhythm game from the Memories Room, the game now returns to the previous UI state after play.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the jump behavior in Volleyball.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]About Timing Adjustment[/h3][p]Since SE (sound effects) are played when you input, setting the offset value too large may cause the sounds to feel out of sync.[/p][p]We strongly recommend playing in a low-latency environment, such as using a wired keyboard or wired headphones.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]【End of Demo Release Notice】[/h3][p]As it has become difficult to continue fixing bugs and supporting consoles for the demo alongside the full version, the distribution of the Pastel☆Parade demo will end at the end of August.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the feedback we received from the demo, we were able to improve many aspects in the full version. We sincerely thank everyone who has played the demo![/p][p][/p][p]From now on, we will focus all our efforts on updating the full version to deliver an even more enjoyable experience. Please continue to enjoy the full version! 🎶[/p]

notes.title: 🎵 ver 1.0.1 Update 🎵
notes.content: [p]We have made the following adjustments in ver 1.0.1![/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a hint for accessing the Memories Room.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint about input methods.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a UI on the pause screen that allows retrying the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the note chart for Song [spoiler]3-4[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where any “Miss” shown during gameplay will now always be reflected as a Miss in the results screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sound effects would play when hovering over the UI while another active window was in front.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor and its input are now disabled when using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where graphics appeared incorrectly for a few frames after retrying Kenkenpa.[/p][/*][*][p]The pause behavior (time not stopping) was originally based on core sync logic, but since many players gave feedback, we revised the implementation so that time now stops when paused.[/p][/*][/list][p]In ver 1.0.1a:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tutorial was disabled in Song X.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the guitar sound did not stop when pausing in Band mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for all the reviews and feedback![/p][p]We look forward to your continued support![/p]

notes.title: 🎵 Demo 1.03 Update 🎵
notes.content:
The following adjustments have been made in Demo 1.03:

Main updates:
[list]
[*] Overall rhythm game: Added a tutorial explanation character
[*] 1-1: Further improvements to better convey controls
[*] 1-1X: Fixed a bug where the sample character sometimes did not hold a bottle
[*] Adjusted UI layout such as in the Options menu
[*] Refined input judgment logic
[/list]

notes.title: 🎵 Demo 1.02 Update 🎵
notes.content:
The following adjustments have been made in Demo 1.02:

Main Update:
[list]
[*] Area Map: Medals are now displayed on the song selection screen.
[*] Result: Added a retry button.
[*] Music Select: Now only shows songs that have been played at least once.
[*] 1-4: Fixed band-related errors.
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug when deleting save data.
[*] Fixed a bug where timing adjustments were not working correctly.
[/list]

If you become unable to progress after deleting your save data, please try deleting it again after updating. We apologize for the inconvenience. 🙏
